reference.title: Troubleshooting
reference.shortdesc: Common issues and actions to try when using the Hospital Management System.

row.entry: Verify your credentials. If the problem continues, contact your system administrator.
Insufficient access or incorrect patient selection
Confirm that you selected the correct patient and that your role has permission to view the record.
Search criteria do not match an appointment
Review the search criteria and try again.
Required information is missing or the recipient is invalid
Review the message fields and verify the selected patient or recipient.

section.title: Security and privacy
section.p: Access patient information only when you are authorized to do so. Follow your organization's policies for protecting patient information, passwords, and messages.
